item.title: Wine Tasting Notes: Boring, Baffling and Banal
item.description: WHY I DON’T DO TASTING NOTES Part I A friend of mine recently posted a comment on Facebook about my web site. He said that anyone interested in champagne, particularly grower champagnes, could find just about anything they wanted on my site, except tasting notes. That may surprise some people, so I thought I should explain why I don’t believe in tasting notes.
